review_randomize_env: review the randomize_env method to understand how swing offset, extension offset, desired pitch, battery voltage, and motor damping are randomized
refactor_randomizer: refactor MinitaurAlternatingLegsEnvRandomizer to support configurable battery voltage and motor damping ranges
